reviews.comment: Daily quizzes, study problems from the textbook, overall good prof.
Not a bad professor, even though attendance isn't required there was daily quizzes worth a big chunk of the grade. Easy class, tests were not bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's not that bad but her lectures are basically pointless most days but each and every lecture carries a daily quiz so attendance is required and each missed class drops your grade a percent or two. Tests aren't bad but if you dont understand kinematics already this class will be hard. She gives examples for problems in class which helps a little

Considering the amount of material that is required to be taught to us within one semester, she is doing a terrific job at it. If you go to every single lecture, and make sure to get help if you don't understand a topic as most of it builds on top of each other, there's no reason to not make a good grade in this class..

Very respectable and tests are easy if you follow instructions and make a decent cheat sheet. If you don't like her, you either don't pay attention or haven't given the time to lock in at least for the exams. She was great and the class was super easy imo. The class is easy to follow and very well structured.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jin Congrui is a good professor and does her job well. Lectures are really straightforward and she's very accessible outside of class and is really helpful in office hours. There are attendance quizzes every class period, but they are not graded harshly. I would take this professor again.

Jin does an amazing job teaching the course. She made it clear from the start what her grading was based on. Attendance is mandatory for the quiz and make up a good amount of the grade but they aren't too difficult. I think she does a great job teaching.

Jin clearly states what we need to know for the exams and when we have quizzes. Just go over the slides and practice the problems she has. The examples in class are very useful for the quizzes she gives us. She's also very helpful if you ask her.
